senses.gloss: ch. samecover, shade, baldachin; esp. bridal chamber, state-room.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 14:13">Targ. Y. Gen. XIV, 13</cite> <he>גננא</he> cover.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 4:5">Targ. Is. IV, 5</cite> <he>בגנון</he> (read <he>כג׳</he>, ed. Lag. <he>כגנין</he>, h. text <he>חפה</he>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 15:32">Targ. Job XV, 32</cite> Var. his enclosure (v. <cite ref="K00557"><he>כִּילְּתָא</he></cite>) shall not be <cite ref="C01107"><he>גנונא</he></cite> ed. Lag. (ed. <he>גננא</he>) a (wreathed) state-room (h. text <he>רעננה</he>; cmp.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 2:1">Targ. Y. Ex. II, 1</cite> <he>גי׳ דהילולא</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 19:6">Targ. Ps. XIX, 6</cite>; a. e.—Y. Yeb. XIII, 13ᶜ bot. <he>עבד לה גנון</he> if a bridal room is prepared for her.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:15">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> they went <he>מיעבד גְּנוּנֵיה דר׳ וכ׳</he> to prepare the bridal chamber of &c.; Bab.
<cite ref="Berakhot 16a:3">Ber. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>קטרין ליה גננא</he> wreathed the bridal chamber of &c.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:24">Ruth R. to I, 17</cite> (sect. 3) [read:] <he>דיהא גְנוּנָךְ חסר וכ׳</he> that thy state-room in the hereafter have one jewel less than &c., i.e. that the jewel given thee in this world be deducted from thy future reward.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:22">Targ. Job XL, 22</cite>.
